title: Daily routine — mid-low (~5.5)
notes: Can narrate a day with some linking; still limited complexity.

turns.text: What does a typical weekday look like for you?
I usually wake up at seven. Then I take bus to work. In the morning I check emails and have meetings.
Do you prefer mornings or evenings?
I prefer mornings because my mind is clearer. At night I feel tired and I just watch some videos.
Would you change anything about your routine?
Yes, I want to exercise more. Now I sit too long, so maybe I will walk after dinner.

fc.comment: Generally maintains flow with basic sequencers.
evidence: Then I take bus to work

lr.comment: Adequate for familiar topics; little paraphrase.

gra.comment: Mix of correct simple forms with occasional article slips.

items.quote: Then I take bus to work.
items.correction: Then I take the bus to work.
items.why: Use 'the bus' for the habitual means of transport.
model: Then I take the bus to work.

highlights.note: Natural reason phrase for time-of-day preference.
